en: The image depicts a vintage postcard with a colored illustration of a lighthouse on a shore, with boats and ships on the water and trees on the land. The scene is tranquil, with a mix of natural and human elements. The top text says 'Salut de Constantinople' (Greetings from Constantinople), and the lighthouse is labeled 'Fanaraki.' The lower part contains handwritten French text, typical of early 20th-century postcards.
